about: Range rate (m/s, + receding) at the centre of the closest chunk of every theta gw_reduce.py measured with its unstretched floor replica (reductions before 2026-11-17, proposals without replica = 'stretched'), keyed '<sat as the proposal names it>|<measured_utc>', and replica_corr_ns, what guowang_db.py adds to such a theta: -0.5 ms x range rate / c + 30.547 ns x sign(range rate). basis 'summary': the reducer's own chunk centre and element set; 'summary ranges': a cubic through the reducer's chunk ranges; 'tle': the newest element set at or before measured_utc + 0.5 s. Built once by ~/gnss/builds/gw1202/gw_replica_rates.py (guowang_paper review/REPLY_GUOWANG_20261117c.md); it never grows: the fixed reducer writes range_rate_m_s in each proposal. sign_uncertain: the keys whose 'tle' rate is under 100 m/s (that basis is good to 9 m/s rms, 54 worst), so the sign of the half sample is not known; never adopted.
